ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes through the target → Line Tempo wolf → Circle Rhythm for shield and speed → All-Kill! once Track is maxed
ourKits.winCondition: hit heroes with abilities to max Track, then cast All-Kill! to drop a wolf pack on every hero she recently damaged
ourKits.passive: Biting Melody adds magical damage on-hit; every few seconds an empowered basic applies Track and restores mana
ourKits.playWith: teammates who engage or slow so she can dash in and land every ability for Track
ourKits.playAgainst: All-Kill! only works once she has stacked Track, so do not trade abilities with her for free; fight after Rushing Beat charges are spent, burst through Circle Rhythm's shield, and buy magical armor if she gets ahead

ourKits.combo: Void Breach slows, the empowered basic attaches a Cosmic Tether that roots, Cosmic Rift lands on the rooted target, then Black Hole drags the group together
ourKits.winCondition: land Black Hole and Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for area burst
ourKits.passive: hitting a hero with an ability empowers his next basic attack to tether the target, dealing damage then rooting them
ourKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Void Breach and Cosmic Rift; Torn Space is his only escape, so dive him after it is used; walk out of Black Hole early since it drags slowly; magic armor blunts his burst

ourKits.combo: Peekaboo! to mark, reveal and slow → Knock, Knock! snipe on the marked target → Back It Up! to drag a fleeing hero back
ourKits.winCondition: land Knock, Knock! on Peekaboo!-marked targets for max-health damage and reset Surprise, Surprise! on takedowns
ourKits.passive: his vision item becomes a camouflaged Sonar Drone that reveals enemies through walls
ourKits.playWith: engage that holds targets still for his snipe, and teammates who follow up when Back It Up! returns a hero
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Peekaboo! since Knock, Knock! is much stronger on marked targets; after Back It Up! teleports you back, expect a follow-up, and pressure him after Surprise, Surprise! is spent

ourKits.combo: Riplash to pull a hero in, Shock Therapy to break their shield and silence, Electrocute aura for damage and a shield, then Skewer to suppress everyone in front of him.
ourKits.winCondition: Land Riplash and chain silence and suppress so the target cannot fight back while their cooldowns stay frozen.
ourKits.passive: Suspended Sentence: while his abilities immobilize or silence a hero, their cooldowns stop ticking.
ourKits.playWith: Burst that deletes his pulled or suppressed target.
ourKits.playAgainst: Stay behind minions or spaced so Riplash cannot reach you, and fight while it is on cooldown. Tenacity shortens the chain, which also shortens the cooldown freeze.

ourKits.combo: Lash Kick in for the slow → Windburn for range and cleave → third-hit max-health damage and heal → Backlash to push away, Quelling Gale to stop projectiles
ourKits.winCondition: stick with Lash Kick, ramp Rising Storm attack speed and out-trade with Windburn's healing third hits
ourKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks from basics and Lash Kick grant attack speed
ourKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick off isolated targets
ourKits.playAgainst: Backlash reflects projectiles and Quelling Gale halts them, so use melee or ground effects while they are up; fight after Lash Kick is used, and buy anti-heal against Windburn

enemyKits.combo: Plasma Grenade slow → Air Assault to hover with extra range → Hypercharge burst → Atomiser to finish a low target
enemyKits.winCondition: hover with Air Assault for extra basic range and shred with Hypercharge, refreshing it on takedowns
enemyKits.passive: extra jump height; kills make the target explode, much larger from enemy heroes
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that holds enemies in place while she hovers and fires
enemyKits.playAgainst: Air Assault is her only reposition, so engage after it ends and she is back on the ground; dodge Plasma Grenade's slow and sidestep the Atomiser channel, which stops on the first hero hit

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
enemyKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
enemyKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
enemyKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Mark a hero, land Hive to slow and stack Pestilence, run through them with Swarm, then cast Curse on the Marked target to cash the Mark in.
enemyKits.winCondition: Keep Pestilence stacked on a squishy with Hive and Swarm, then finish them with Curse while Mark and Swarm heal her through the trade.
enemyKits.passive: Pestilence: her damaging abilities stack a max-health magical damage over time, and Fetid Dagger hits refresh it.
enemyKits.playWith: Lane partners or junglers with setup that hold her Marked target in place for Curse.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Dodge Hive, since its slow sets up everything else, and trade when Swarm is down because it is her damage reduction, speed and main heal. Anti-heal cuts the healing from Mark and Swarm.

enemyKits.combo: Glacial Charge dashes in, Boreal Sweep slows, Hoarfrost roots enemies that touch the ring, then Cryoseism slows and stuns a target before it explodes
enemyKits.winCondition: chain slow, root and stun to lock fights down while her Frost Storm grinds max-health damage
enemyKits.passive: jumping mid-air leaps her and leaves a Replica that draws tower aggro; hitting a Hero or Monster 4 times summons a Frost Storm
enemyKits.playWith: burst damage that turns her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: do not walk into the Hoarfrost ring while it persists; Cryoseism slows before it stuns, so cleanse or tenacity help, and spread so the explosion does not chain; she is weak once Glacial Charge is down

enemyKits.combo: Judgement of the Heavens to tether, Surge of the Heavens into the Blade to knock up and stun, Light of the Heavens for true damage at the Blade, Fury of the Heavens to teleport and slow.
enemyKits.winCondition: Tether a target with the Blade, knock them up by dashing into it, and brawl with Energized basics that cut his cooldowns.
enemyKits.passive: Strike of the Heavens Energizes his basics after ability hits, adding attack speed, lightning damage and cooldown reduction.
enemyKits.playWith: Follow-up damage while he tethers and knocks up.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Watch where the Blade lands: it tethers, Surge into it knocks up, and Fury teleports him to it. Move away from the Blade and fight after Surge is used.

Fury of the Heavens at rank 3: 85s base, about 53.8s by the end (37% shorter) from 58 ability haste: Spirit Of Amir 10, Gaussian Greaves 10, Prophecy 15, Flux Matrix 15, Tempest 8.
Kwang dealt 27,687 hero damage, 21% of their team's, with +240 magical power from items.

Penetration: Spirit Of Amir 7; against Shinbi (level 17: about 60 magical armor, 53 after penetration; took 27,948 magical damage from heroes, 73% of all hero damage they took) and Yin (level 15: about 44 magical armor, 37 after penetration; took 16,682 magical damage from heroes, 71% of all hero damage they took) that is about 5% and 5% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Spirit Of Amir (item): Abilities deal 12% more damage to Monsters.
Gaussian Greaves (item): Gain the ability to Double Jump while mid-air. After Double Jumping, emit a shockwave upon landing. Deals 100 (+50%) Damage. Slows by 40% for 1.25s.
Prophecy (item): On Basic Attacks: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage On-Hit.
Flux Matrix (item): Nearby Enemy Heroes: Take 10% additional Magical Damage. Have their Tenacity decreased by 50%.
Tempest (crest): Deal 15 (+15%) Damage to 3 nearby Heroes every second for 7s. Heal equal to 35% of the damage dealt. Additional hits against the same Target deal 20% Damage.
Vesh (Eternal): Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 19.4% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.
Millennia (Eternal minor): Every 60s, increase your Ultimate Ability Damage by 0.75%.
Slayer of the Heavens (augment): Strike of the Heavens deals 25% more damage and reduces Cooldowns by 25% more.

Sustain: Tempest: Deal 15 (+15%) Damage to 3 nearby Heroes every second for 7s. Heal equal to 35% of the damage dealt. Additional hits against the same Target deal 20% Damage.; Lich: Gain 4%/7%/10%/14% Magical Lifesteal at Levels 1/6/11/16.; 14,423 healing recorded.
Toughness: +800 health, +35 physical armor, +45 magical armor; took 47,757 damage, mitigated 45,785, died 1 times.

Loadout augment Slayer of the Heavens: Your energized lightning basic attacks hit harder and cut your cooldowns more. Weave a basic attack after every ability so Judgement and Surge come back faster. (game text: Strike of the Heavens deals 25% more damage and reduces Cooldowns by 25% more.) (changes Strike of the Heavens) Field: 47.2% in 4858 games, 86% of picks, level the hero-role's 47.2%.

Loadout Eternal Vesh: Every ability hit leaves a short burn. Judgement, Light of the Heavens, Surge and Fury of the Heavens all add extra damage after the combo lands. (game text: Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% per minute) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.) [7% growing 0.4% a minute: about 19.4% by the end (31 min)] Field: 44.8% in 2650 games, 47% of picks, below the hero-role's 47.2%.

Loadout minor Lich: Magic lifesteal that grows with level. Judgement, Fury, Light of the Heavens while holding the Blade and his lightning strikes deal magic damage, so trading in lane keeps you topped up. (game text: Gain 4%/7%/10%/14% Magical Lifesteal at Levels 1/6/11/16.) Field: 44.8% in 2458 games, 93% of picks, below the hero-role's 47.2%.

Loadout minor Millennia: Your ultimate's damage slowly grows over the game. A small late-game boost to Fury of the Heavens; nothing else changes. (game text: Every 60s, increase your Ultimate Ability Damage by 0.75%.) Field: 43.6% in 1735 games, 65% of picks, below the hero-role's 47.2%.

Loadout crest Tempest: Zaps up to 3 nearby heroes every second and heals you. Pop it as you dive in with Surge of the Heavens to help you survive in the middle of a fight. (game text: Overcharge:  Deal 15 (+15%) Damage to 3 nearby Heroes every second for 7s. Heal equal to 35% of the damage dealt. Additional hits against the same Target deal 20% Damage.) Field: 46.4% in 2101 games, 37% of picks, level the hero-role's 47.2%.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Spirit Of Amir, Tempest, Lich.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Spirit Of Amir, Vesh. Kwang has 4 damaging abilities (Light of the Heavens, Judgement of the Heavens, Surge of the Heavens, Fury of the Heavens hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 58 ability haste brought them back 37% sooner: more casts, more triggers.

The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Lich + Millennia) sits on the same triggers as the items (healing off the damage; every ability hit set off), so the same fights paid out in both damage and staying power.
Countered? 0 of the 2 players Kwang killed built magical armor. Anti-heal on Yin. We killed Kwang 1 time.
Copy it? Vesh (Lich + Millennia): 43.6% in 1,627 Kwang jungle games, below the hero's 47.2%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

card.lesson: Fury of the Heavens came back about every 54s instead of 85s by the end (37% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.

bullets: Hive, Mark and Swarm hits set off Combustion's area burst whenever off cooldown, and Wraith Leggings added 12% bonus magical damage to abilities against heroes below 40% health.
Vesh turned ability hits on heroes into extra damage over time, Mind Rot added damage from the target's current health, and Lich's magical lifesteal healed Morigesh.
Astral Catalyst cut Curse's cooldown by 25% per kill and 15% per assist, and Overseer made Curse hit 15% harder and heal Morigesh for 25% of hero damage.
Line Tempo, Rushing Beat and Circle Rhythm set off Combustion's area burst when off cooldown; 30 ability haste from Prophecy and Magnify meant more casts and Pilow pulses.
Every ability cast pulsed Pilow, weakening nearby enemy heroes' damage; Neurotoxin made debuffed heroes take more damage; Harmonic Currents restored some missing health and mana.
Prophecy added on-hit damage to basic attacks, while ability hits on heroes built Track toward unlocking All-Kill!, whose cooldown ended 23% shorter from the haste.
Vesh added damage over time to every ability hit on heroes, Lich healed Kwang off magical damage, and Millennia grew Fury of the Heavens' damage each minute.
Flux Matrix made nearby enemy heroes take 10% more magical damage, boosting Judgement of the Heavens and Fury of the Heavens, both magical hits.
50 ability haste from four items cut Fury of the Heavens to about 56.7s, and Light of the Heavens shielded Kwang while holding the Blade.
